updateOffset.title: Update offset
updateOffset.desc: Offsets the spotlight up and down to enable use with weird camera perspectives.

resetOffset.title: Reset offset
resetOffset.desc: Resets the spotlight offset back to 0°

ToggleSpotlight.title: Spotlight toggle
